note: Both sets transcribe Table 6-1 correctly: every stiffness, inertia and cg-offset value is bound to the right property and the right Elevation/HtFract row, and the overall tower mass (347,460 kg) is quoted accurately. The sets are identical except that A adds two more zero cg-offset entries (TwFAcgOf and TwSScgOf = 0.0 m at Elevation 87.60 m), which are correct but of negligible engineering content since both offsets are zero at every station. Both sets repeat the same facts two or three times (e.g. TwFAStif 115.82E+9 at 87.60 m, TwSSStif 614.34E+9 at 0.00 m) and both omit the TMassDen column and the 38.234 m mass-center location. Net difference is only trivial zero-value coverage, so the sets are effectively equivalent.
remarks: Both sets ignore the TMassDen column entirely (5590.87 kg/m at the base down to 2536.27 kg/m at the top) and the stated overall mass center at 38.234 m — the sentence is cut off in the text layer ('along the') but the value is legible in the image. Each set states 8 of its claims twice (unit notation varies between N•m2 and N*m^2 for the same fact). Several quotes use '...' reconstructions rather than literal page text; values are still correct. Coverage is limited to the 0.00 m and 87.60 m rows; the intermediate nine rows are unclaimed in both.
